aiFit.title: AI Fit Analysis
aiFit.subtitle: An optional, advisory copilot that assesses how an application fits a vacancy's scorecard criteria. Only the owner can change this setting.
aiFit.enableHelp: Adds a collapsed advisory card to each candidate profile. It never scores the person, never advances or rejects anyone, and hides the candidate's name and other protected details from the model.
aiFit.acknowledgement: I understand AI Fit Analysis is advisory only: it produces no overall score, a human always makes the decision and must record an assessment, and outputs are based only on job-relevant evidence. Under the EU AI Act this is a limited-risk, human-in-the-loop use and my organisation acknowledges these terms.
aiFit.onNotice: AI Fit Analysis is on. Recruiters will see the advisory card on candidate profiles.
aiFit.offNotice: AI Fit Analysis is off. The card is hidden everywhere.

apply.aiReviewTitle: How your application may be reviewed
apply.aiReviewBody: {company} may use an AI assistant to help recruiters see how your application matches this role's requirements. It is advisory only: a person always makes the hiring decision, it produces no automated score and rejects no one, and it assesses only job-relevant information — your name and other personal details are hidden from it. You can ask {company} for more information about how it is used.

apply.privacyIntro: By submitting this form, you're sharing your personal data with {company} — the company recruiting for this position and the data controller for your application. HRHandle operates this form on their behalf as a data processor.
apply.privacyCollect: What we collect. The contact details and CV you submit. If you uploaded a CV, the file is processed through automated extraction to pre-fill the form fields; no automated hiring decision is taken. We also record the IP address of the submission to prevent abuse.
apply.privacyRetention: How long we keep it. Your application is retained while {company} actively considers candidates, and deleted within 30 days of {company} closing the role or terminating their HRHandle subscription.
apply.privacyRights: Your rights. You can ask to access, correct, or delete your data, or restrict processing. To exercise these rights for this application, contact {company} directly. For HRHandle's role as data processor, see our
